contracts.purpose: Represents a normal scalar-track container for one or more curve bindings.

kind.meaning: The semantic kind of the track container.
kind.mapping: Use kind normal for a normal track.

title.meaning: The requested human-readable title of this track.
title.mapping: Use an explicit track title from the authoritative request.

bindings.meaning: Ordered curve bindings belonging to this track.
bindings.mapping: Preserve requested binding order and multiplicity.

distinctions: A normal track is not a source candidate and does not select a filesystem path.
A track title is not a curve scale.
examples: A normal track titled Calibration can contain a curve binding for CALX.
provenance: SectionSemanticDraft track kind and title fields
typed section context validator track-shape invariant

contracts.purpose: Represents an array-track container whose horizontal coordinate may have a numeric domain.

kind.meaning: The semantic kind of the track container.
kind.mapping: Use kind array for an array track.

title.meaning: The requested human-readable title of this track.
title.mapping: Use an explicit track title from the authoritative request.

x_scale.meaning: The horizontal coordinate range of the array track.
x_scale.mapping: Phrases such as x scale, horizontal scale, or horizontal range A to B map to track.x_scale.minimum=A and track.x_scale.maximum=B when they refer to the array track.

bindings.meaning: Ordered raster bindings belonging to this array track.
bindings.mapping: Preserve requested binding order and multiplicity.

distinctions: track.x_scale is the array-track horizontal coordinate range.
track.x_scale is not binding.scale, which belongs to an individual curve binding.
An array track does not authorize channels outside the resolved source context.
examples: An array track titled Array View can use ARRAY_X with x scale 10 to 90.
provenance: SectionSemanticDraft array track and x_scale fields
typed section context validator array/raster invariant

contracts.purpose: Represents one scalar source channel drawn as a curve.

channel.meaning: The exact mnemonic of the selected scalar source channel.
channel.mapping: Use an exact channel mnemonic supplied by the resolved source context.

scale.meaning: The numeric horizontal display scale of this individual curve.
scale.mapping: A channel-specific range maps to binding.scale. A linear scale maps kind linear; logarithmic or log scale maps kind log; tangential scale maps kind tangential; explicit reverse or reversed maps reverse true.

distinctions: Do not use track.x_scale for the numeric scale of an individual scalar curve.
Do not infer reverse when the authoritative request does not request reversal.
A repeated channel in separate requested views remains separate bindings.
examples: CALX with a linear scale from -25 to 75 maps its range to binding.scale.
A requested reversed curve preserves reverse=true in binding.scale.
provenance: SectionSemanticDraft curve binding channel and scale fields
semantic scale validator kind and reverse invariants

contracts.purpose: Represents array samples from one selected source channel.

channel.meaning: The exact mnemonic of the selected array source channel.
channel.mapping: Use an exact array channel mnemonic supplied by the resolved source context.

profile.meaning: The semantic interpretation family of the raster samples.
profile.mapping: Generic raster maps to generic; waveform raster maps to waveform; VDL raster maps to vdl.

sample_axis.meaning: The physical or sample coordinate associated with the raster sample dimension.
sample_axis.mapping: Sample unit U maps to sample_axis.unit; source origin X maps to source_axis.source_origin; source step X maps to sample_axis.source_step; N ticks maps to sample_axis.tick_count.

distinctions: sample_axis describes the raster sample dimension, not the array track horizontal x_scale.
source_origin is the coordinate of the first source sample.
source_step is the distance between consecutive source samples.
tick_count is the requested number of displayed sample-axis ticks.
Profile names describe semantic raster interpretation and are not source filenames.
examples: A synthetic waveform raster named ARRAY_W can use profile waveform.
A sample unit ms, source origin 12, source step 2, and 5 ticks map to sample_axis fields.
provenance: SectionSemanticDraft raster binding profile and sample_axis fields
sample-axis and raster-profile semantic enum invariants
